metadata.name: writewise_feedback_scoring_kb_v3
metadata.description: Enhanced contextual knowledge base for stage-aware feedback evaluation and scoring in AI-assisted academic writing systems
metadata.author: M4 Feedback Scoring Module
metadata.notes: Enhanced KB with contextual retrieval grounding, stage-aware reasoning, history consistency modeling, and clarity-aware scoring for IT undergraduate research article writing. Stage labels standardised to Title Case (Planning/Implementation/Revision) to align with the Final_feedback_clarity_score_with_improvements KB. Clarity scoring scale documented for cross-KB reference.

scoring_scale.conversion_note: Multiply this_kb clarity values by 100 for rough comparability with the external clarity model's scale. Scales are not statistically equivalent; treat conversion as directional only.

metadata.clarity_levels_aligned_with: Final_feedback_clarity_score_with_improvements Clarity_Level taxonomy (Excellent, Good, Average, Poor, Very Poor). This KB currently has example coverage for 3 of those 5 levels: Excellent, Average, Very Poor.

Planning.description: User is defining research objectives, problem statements, datasets, methodology, and project scope.

Implementation.description: User is describing technical implementation, workflows, models, architecture, APIs, and system functionality.

Revision.description: User is refining readability, formatting, citations, clarity, grammar, and logical flow.

excellent_clarity: Describe the preprocessing workflow step by step.
Explain how JWT authentication validates user sessions.
Provide examples for each evaluation metric.
Rewrite long sentences into shorter readable statements.
Clearly explain how the recommendation engine generates outputs.
average_clarity: Expand this section with more details.
Add more information to this section.

consistent_feedback.new_feedback: Explain how the selected methodology supports the objectives.
Explain how missing values were handled.

high_impact: Feedback directly resolves a writing weakness.
low_impact: Feedback is unrelated to the stage.

planning.current_content: The proposed system aims to predict student academic performance using supervised learning algorithms.
planning.previous_content: This research focuses on identifying factors affecting undergraduate academic success.
planning.feedback: Clearly define your research problem before selecting a machine learning model.

planning.previous_content: Previous studies discussed misinformation spread across social media platforms.
planning.feedback: Identify research gaps before defining your methodology.

planning.previous_content: The introduction chapter described AI-assisted academic support systems.
planning.feedback: Define measurable project objectives before implementation.

planning.previous_content: The literature review discussed deep learning techniques for image analysis.
planning.feedback: Select suitable datasets before training the CNN model.

planning.current_content: The methodology section currently describes data collection but lacks evaluation procedures.
planning.previous_content: The prototype user interface was developed using React and Tailwind CSS.

planning.current_content: The objectives section explains the system goals but lacks measurable outcomes.

planning.current_content: The project scope currently includes both desktop and mobile users without identifying the target audience.
planning.previous_content: The final proofreading process corrected formatting inconsistencies.

planning.current_content: Model performance will be evaluated using accuracy, recall, precision, and F1-score metrics.
planning.previous_content: The proposal document defined the problem statement and expected outcomes.

planning.current_content: The introduction chapter discusses AI-based systems but does not clearly define the research problem.
planning.previous_content: The architecture diagram illustrated frontend-backend communication.

implementation.previous_content: The planning phase finalized the system requirements and architecture design.

implementation.previous_content: The dataset description identified the structure of collected training data.

implementation.current_content: The system architecture section briefly explains communication between frontend services and the recommendation engine.

implementation.previous_content: The methodology chapter described preprocessing and feature extraction techniques.

implementation.current_content: The API integration process enables communication between the mobile application and backend services.
implementation.previous_content: The frontend implementation section described React-based UI components.
implementation.feedback: Provide sequence diagrams to explain how API requests are processed between services.

implementation.current_content: The testing section currently lacks detailed explanations about system evaluation procedures.
implementation.previous_content: The planning phase finalized research objectives and evaluation criteria.
implementation.feedback: Fix grammar mistakes in the conclusion chapter.

implementation.current_content: The implementation chapter explains the authentication module but lacks technical depth regarding token validation.
implementation.previous_content: The implementation workflow documented database design and API endpoints.

revision.current_content: Several APA citations in the references section use inconsistent formatting styles.
revision.previous_content: The testing chapter documented system evaluation procedures and performance analysis.
revision.feedback: Apply consistent APA citation formatting across all references and in-text citations.

revision.current_content: The abstract exceeds the word limit and contains unnecessary background information.
revision.previous_content: The introduction chapter was proofread to improve readability and grammar.
